verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-style event pipeline, so audience activation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only event streaming to warehouses and SaaS destinations, plus Profile Builder writing customer profiles to the warehouse. Nothing documents defining audiences or syncing audience membership (entries and exits) to ad platforms or engagement tools, continuously or otherwise. Event delivery and warehouse profiles are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time
